'''Dorn''' was a young [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. A friend of young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Dorn was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who was training him to be a spy.

When Jabba realized that a group of [[Ghostling]] children had been abducted by his rival [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]], Jabba decided to have Dorn infiltrate Gardulla's palace and locate them. Though nearly captured in his efforts to undermine both Hutts and help the other children escape, he made it safely to [[Bantha Rock]] in the end. With the other enslaved beings, he boarded [[Rakir Banai]]'s ship and fled the system.
